name: ihav-web-visit-counter
description: Monthly website traffic estimates with source and analysis date, or an honest rank when no estimate exists.

interface.shortDescription: Website traffic estimates with analysis date and rank-only fallback
interface.longDescription: Give a URL or domain. Get a provider-modelled monthly visits estimate with its analysis date and source link. If that source has no result, get a Tranco rank with monthly visits left unknown. No API key, paid service or browser is required.
defaultPrompt: How many monthly visits does example.com get?
Show the traffic history for example.com.
Which countries are in example.com's traffic estimate?
